text:
Sam: Quick thread — planning v1->v2 deprecation rollout. Need a way to grant temporary exemptions for specific customers/routes without breaking billing or routing. Thoughts?

Maya: +1. Lots of enterprise customers ask for stable token accounting. We should avoid changing their quota math mid-contract.

Kevin: We could support a header flag like `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` or extend `X-Model-Version`. Router checks header first, then fall back to normal routing.

Sam: header opt-in seems simplest for pinned integrations. Any objections about surface area?

Kevin: no objections. Example middleware sketch: ```
if req.headers['x-redwood-compat']== 'v1' { routeTo(legacyPool) } else { routeTo(v2Pool) }
```

Priya: Telemetry note: emit `deprecation.exempt_request` with customer_id + route, and add a metric `v1_exempt_tokens:{customer}`. We'll need an alert for sudden spikes (fraud risk).

Maya: Console UX: show a per-route deprecation banner with two actions: "Request exemption" (creates a ticket + populates customer/route info) and "Pin to v2". Banner copy should include the planned cutoff date and token calc differences.

infra-bot: Feature flag created: `ff/deprecations/grace_exemptions` (owner: @Kevin). Rollout target: 0% -> 25% -> 100% after QA.

Kevin: Quota semantics: exempt routes should use legacy quota calc but with an enforced monthly cap to prevent abuse. Propose `max_exempt_tokens_per_month` and a soft alert when customer exceeds 80%.

Sam: Agree on cap. Also we need to capture fallback rate (how often v2 fails and we fall back to v1) and error delta (v1 vs v2 error rates). If fallback_rate > 2% for a customer, flag for SE outreach.

Priya: I'd avoid auto-granting additional exemptions based on metrics alone — that could be gamed. Better to surface an alert to SE and product ops.

Maya: For the console request flow, include checkboxes: contract_protected, sla_required, privacy_regulated. This will help ops route requests to sales/legal automatically.

Kevin: Implementation tasks I see: header parsing, router rule, feature flag gate, legacyQuota path. I can take the router + flag.

Priya: I'll add the telemetry events + dashboards: `v1_exempt_requests`, `v1_exempt_tokens_by_customer`, `v1_fallback_rate`, and an alert runbook.

Sam: Action items: Kevin -> infra PR for header/routing + ff. Priya -> telemetry + alert. Maya -> console banner + request flow mock. I'll sync with legal on exemption contract language. We'll iterate on wording next week. :thumbsup:

Kevin: One more: we should log a short, consistent reason field when granting exemptions so we can query later: `reason=contract|regulatory|se-request|safety`.

Maya: Good call. That'll help audits.

Sam: Cool — will set a 2pm sync Friday to review PRs and dashboard mocks. Thanks all.
